adversarial_claim: A correction adds a second vote beside the success it supersedes, or the snapshot keeps the superseded success.

events.rationale: Draft 14.5, row 'Execution completed with data returned': EXECUTION, SUCCESS, reliability. It contributes one positive unit until correction-event-0002 supersedes it (14.6 rule 10); at the end of the case it contributes nothing and is listed in superseded_event_ids, not qualified_event_ids (15.2).

Draft 14.6 rule 10: same task_id, operation_id, dimension and reporter as the event it supersedes; scored as one event with its own result FAILURE and observed_at in place of execution-event-0001; 14.3: corrections do not add a second vote.
